requirements.research_statement: Yandex Search is designed to solve the user's task using relevant and useful information.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Describe the ordinary-Search task from persisted Yandex evidence for the exact query, including dominant page type/format/angle, orientation and specificity.
requirements.failure_policy: If saved Search evidence is materially missing/stale/contradictory, do not invent the task; trigger evidence-gap handling before verdict.
requirements.claim_boundary: Search task is an analyst description of observed Yandex results, not a provider-native intent label.
requirements.acceptance_check: ordinary Search side complete for 8/8 cases

requirements.research_statement: GenSearch exposes message, sources with used flags, and refined searchQueries; used=true means the document was used in the answer.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Read corrected Step-16 authority/raw and describe exact-query GenSearch task/orientation, answer mode, refined queries and used sources.
requirements.failure_policy: Missing/ambiguous evidence -> INSUFFICIENT rather than fabricated provider facts.
requirements.claim_boundary: GenSearch-specific only; not consumer Alice or Webmaster Alice visibility.

requirements.research_statement: Executed evidence is exact-query GenSearch evidence and must not be broadened into generic user-job-family or cross-platform AI claims.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Scope every comparison verdict to the tested exact-query evidence and keep GenSearch separate from unobserved AI surfaces.
requirements.failure_policy: Any unsupported broad user-job or generic Alice claim blocks QA.
requirements.claim_boundary: EXACT_QUERY != USER_JOB_FAMILY; GEN_SEARCH != CONSUMER_ALICE; GEN_SEARCH != WEBMASTER_ALICE_VISIBILITY

requirements.research_statement: Source links are not ranked by displayed order; URL/title alone is weak evidence for a material page-role claim.
requirements.execution_scope: decision-relevant used=true sources and target pages
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Open/read a current source/target page whenever the verdict depends materially on its service/product/DIY/comparison/specialist/broad role or actual content capability.
requirements.failure_policy: Unreadable required source -> role unresolved; do not use it decisively. If current target evidence independently invalidates Step14, trigger R17-008 upstream correction rather than AI CHANGE.
requirements.claim_boundary: URL/title is only a weak role hint until direct validation when material.
requirements.acceptance_check: every material source/target role claim has direct evidence

requirements.research_statement: GenSearch documents used flags but no source importance weight; Yandex says consumer-Alice source links are not ranked by link order.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Use source identity/role/used status only; never treat array position or used-source count as rank/weight.
requirements.failure_policy: Any order/count rank inference blocks acceptance.

requirements.research_statement: AI evaluation must preserve uncertainty; Step16 established that single-run evidence cannot prove stable behavior. Consumer-Alice variability is context only and is not direct GenSearch equivalence evidence.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Record reproducibility state for every case. A material architecture-changing contradiction driven by GenSearch cannot receive CHANGE from one unreproduced snapshot.
requirements.availability_or_access_state: 7 SINGLE-RUN CASES; C15-010 TWO SAME-QUERY SHORT-WINDOW RUNS
requirements.provider_or_tool_capability_state: NO NEW CALL REQUIRED BY DEFAULT
requirements.cost_or_quota_boundary: new repeat requires explicit owner authorization
requirements.failure_policy: Single-run material AI contradiction -> INSUFFICIENT for AI-driven CHANGE unless separately authorized reproduction evidence is obtained. Independent non-AI evidence is NOT a substitute for AI reproduction.
requirements.claim_boundary: SHORT_WINDOW_REPEAT != LONG_TERM_STABILITY; no universal repeat count is claimed
requirements.acceptance_check: all AI-driven CHANGE verdicts pass reproduction/evidence-strength gate

requirements.research_statement: Project material-delta taxonomy is CHANGE / DE_RISK / NO_CHANGE / INSUFFICIENT and CHANGE must not be forced.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Assign exactly one final Step17 verdict to every case after the fixed-axis comparison and all blocking gates.
requirements.failure_policy: Ambiguity -> INSUFFICIENT; do not force change/no-change.
requirements.claim_boundary: taxonomy is project-specific, not a Yandex standard

requirements.research_statement: A current-page check can reveal an independent upstream baseline defect. Such a defect must be corrected at its source and cannot be relabeled as an AI-caused Step17 change.
requirements.execution_scope: any case where direct non-AI evidence contradicts Step14 baseline independently of GenSearch
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Set UPSTREAM_BASELINE_CORRECTION_REQUIRED, stop the affected case verdict, correct/re-freeze the affected baseline, then resume the comparison.
requirements.cost_or_quota_boundary: depends on defect; no automatic provider call
requirements.failure_policy: Do not issue final Step17 verdict while the baseline is known wrong/stale.
requirements.acceptance_check: no known invalid baseline remains under a final verdict

requirements.research_statement: Step14 froze Search-only architecture; Step18 is prioritization; Step17 may only apply case-scoped AI-derived deltas instead of rebuilding the full architecture.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Record affected Step14 unit/page, baseline state, proposed AI-derived delta, evidence and coherence recheck. Non-CHANGE units inherit Step14.
requirements.failure_policy: No full architecture rebuild and no prioritization inside Step17.

requirements.research_statement: Fresh provider calls require explicit information gain, cost/retry/persistence and acceptance use.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Reuse same-day persisted evidence. A new request requires exact unresolved question, insufficiency reason, operation/query, information gain, cost, retry boundary, persistence destination, acceptance use and explicit owner authorization.
requirements.required_artifact_field_or_output: fresh_request_needed=false by default; request_justification if triggered

requirements.research_statement: Industry SERP analysis commonly uses content type, format and angle to describe observed search intent.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Use type/format/angle as descriptive fields over Yandex results, not as Yandex-native labels.
requirements.failure_policy: Do not present this framework as a Yandex standard.

requirements.research_statement: Owned Alice visibility is a distinct Webmaster surface and is unavailable in this job.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Record route as unavailable/not executed; do not infer SoV or owned Alice visibility.
requirements.failure_policy: Base Step17 continues while corresponding claims remain forbidden.

requirements.research_statement: Completion requires full accounting, reverse trace, adversarial QA and readback; activity alone is not completion.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Run 8/8 completeness QA, missing-evidence QA, claim-boundary QA, upstream-defect QA, delta-overlay QA and GitHub readback.
requirements.failure_policy: Any blocking finding keeps Step17 incomplete and blocks Step18.
requirements.claim_boundary: STEP_COMPLETE only after required output exists and is verified
